bibl.title: Text as Paratext: Pindar, Sappho, and Alexandrian Editions.
bibl.seg: Enrico Emanuele Prodi, Text as Paratext: Pindar, Sappho, and Alexandrian Editions.
bibl.note: When a Hellenistic editor chose an opening poem for an edition of an earlier poet, the motives and the readerly results can be investigated in the cases of Pindar and Sappho.
